I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful…

“The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and will speak…
He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above…
Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is…

translations.web: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
translations.bsb: There is a generation—how haughty are their eyes and pretentious are their glances—
translations.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
translations.asv: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.
